verdict.rationale: Graphite documents review customization: custom rules that tell Graphite Agent how to review code, comment exclusions that say where it should not comment, and "AI Review customizations" listed as a plan feature. That covers part of the per-instruction idea. Nothing in the evidence shows these settings live in a versioned config file in the repo, or that they can be scoped by path or grouped into review profiles. Missing for 10: a versioned in-repo config file, path filters, per-path instruction scoping, review profiles, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
